_about: Per-photo decisions of the photo review (docs/PHOTOS.md, 'Photo review'). Key: the photo's S3 path (or file name, full URL or sha1(url)[:12]). Fields: route 'lanczos' = no network at all (Lanczos + gentle unsharp mask); protect = [[x, y, w, h], ...] regions in fractions of the photo kept out of the network (Lanczos + unsharp mask there, feathered into the enhanced rest); dni = denoise strength (default 0.25); faceMax = face-guard size limit in source px (default 130); usm = 'amount,threshold[,sigma]'; note = why. Every face under 130 px that the detector finds is protected automatically; the regions below are what it cannot find: deity faces, small lettering, crowds.
